reviewPolicy.approvalScope: Overall appearance of the complete building/asset/scene item, including its listed parts unless Tania names exceptions
reviewPolicy.ambiguousReply: Do not infer asset approval or production authority. Resolve the named batch/assets first.
reviewPolicy.revisionRule: Track every file/version change. Return materially changed appearance to whole-item review; routine changes that preserve accepted appearance need documented technical verification, not a new wall-by-wall approval. Preserve the original decision and exact reviewed item snapshot.
reviewPolicy.requiredEvidence: Exact user instruction, date, approver, item/batch revision and reviewed assembly/component snapshot; named exceptions if any.
reviewPolicy.batchUnit: Complete review item/package, not individual component parts
reviewPolicy.incompleteItemRule: All ten complete appearance candidates must be presented together before requesting Batch 1 approval. Each decision covers its listed unflagged parts.
reviewPolicy.exceptionRule: Only named exceptions need component-specific follow-up. An unflagged wall, flower or other listed part does not require a separate approval.
reviewPolicy.currentProductionAuthority: Tania: ys go; confirmed Use these 10 complete places. This authorises Batch 1 production, not appearance acceptance or game release.
